translation_direction: no → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete Norwegian electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Nora’s bright patter over fear and her sudden cold clarity in the last act, Helmer’s pomposity and Rank’s wry fatalism are kept in spoken stage Vietnamese with no explanatory padding.
decisions.rationale: The play turns on the switch of register at the reckoning.

decisions.decision: The Norwegian text comes from Wikisource because the backlog entry named an English translation; it is translated directly from the Dano-Norwegian.
decisions.rationale: Translation from the original, not from an English version.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: Nora called herself ‘mẹ’ to the nurse Anne-Marie, who raised her; the pair is ‘con/vú’, and ‘mẹ’ is kept only toward her own children.
Krogstad’s ‘tas til nåde igjen’ was rendered in garbled Vietnamese; corrected.
‘Romansproget’ (the language of novels) was rendered as ‘Romance languages’; corrected, and the Capripike pun tightened.
‘Farvel’ was rendered ‘Vĩnh biệt’ (farewell for ever) in Nora’s last word and in units 1204 and 1347, adding a finality the Norwegian lacks; now ‘Từ biệt’.
Rank’s ‘fru Helmer’ was ‘cô Nora’ here and ‘cô Helmer’ elsewhere; unified as ‘cô Helmer’.
‘Vinkelskriver’ was rendered two ways; unified as ‘thầy cãi lậu’.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.draft_rendering: em/anh; from ‘Sett deg, Torvald’ Nora says tôi/anh
glossary.rationale: The change of register marks the end of the pet-name marriage.

glossary.draft_rendering: chim sơn ca nhỏ; sóc nhỏ; chim tiêu hoang; Nora bé bỏng
glossary.rationale: Helmer’s patronising diminutives, one rendering each.

glossary.draft_rendering: điều kỳ diệu / điều kỳ diệu nhất
glossary.rationale: The play’s last line returns to the wonderful thing Nora hoped for.

witness_decision: Selected the Norwegian Wikisource transcription of Et dukkehjem by Henrik Ibsen (1879), which identifies itself as the electronic edition of Terje Sørensen and Heather McNeill from Project Runeberg; the project did not collate it with a printed edition.

unresolved_questions.explanation: The corrected rendering of ‘tas til nåde igjen’ still sounds slightly lordly.
‘Vợ và chồng’ reverses ‘mann og kone’ against the anh/tôi order.
The stage direction for the slamming door is a little awkward.

title_review.rationale: The title is translated as ‘Ngôi nhà búp bê’; no earlier Vietnamese title was checked.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: The cast list: ‘Advokat Helmer. Nora, hans hustru. Doktor Rank. …’
The last unit: the sound of the street door closing below.
